dog.description_text:
Meet Eugene!

Eugene has a wonderfully sweet personality! This handsome guy enjoys getting pets and spending quality time with his people. He's always happy to soak up some affection, especially when a little brushing is involved!

Eugene also has a playful side and enjoys having some fun with toys. Add in some yummy treats, and you've got another way to make this sweet boy's day! He's the perfect combination of affectionate, playful, and a friend.

If you're looking for a sweet companion who enjoys pets, brushing, playtime, and tasty treats, Eugene is ready to meet you!

Click the "Adopt Me" button to learn more!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
